about: The numbers every pcbv change has to beat: spinny-survey baseline grades the survey below (169 pictures of an OreSat battery card, github.com/oresat/oresat-batteries oresat-battery-card at 031b458, under a LumenPnP's top camera on 2026-11-14, 8 by 7.5 mm apart over the board and a margin) with each case's pcbv options against the truth here (its two stale stops left out), and fails when a case has fewer right locks, more wrong ones, or a right rms higher by more than rms_slack_mm. The pictures stay in var/surveys on the machine that took them.

stale.about: Stops whose picture is the stop before's: the camera gave no new frame for a moment and the sweep kept its last one (found on 2026-11-17 by correlating each picture with the one before, 0.99 and 0.999 where no other pair passes 0.76). They are left out of every case; until then stop 46's right lock of the picture it really shows was counted wrong, 8 mm off. spinny-survey sweep now asks again for a picture taken after the head came to rest.

truth.about: head = R(turn_deg) (x, -y) + shift for a KiCad board point (x, y), the head's place over it in the LumenPnP's X and Y, mm: the robust fit of the scale case's 52 right locks

scale.about: pcbv told the scale within a fifth either way of the camera's 0.0161 mm a pixel, too wide a window for its whole-picture search. Since 2026-11-17 a masked board's looks begin with the least of the three colors (pcb-vision fc92675): 20 more pictures lock right and 4 more wrong than the 52 and 54 (of 169) before it, the wrong ones pairing under half of their pads, which the backend's vote leaves out

noscale.about: no scale given: pcbv tries its whole range, then its scale windows; 17 more right and 8 more wrong than the 48 and 68 (of 169) before the look through the least of the three colors

measured.about: the backend's options for a measured camera: the scale 3% either way (vision.SCALE_SPREAD) and the lens Measure camera finds, so pcbv fits a similarity with the scale held to the window and, since 2026-11-17, runs its whole-picture search beside the spots'. Each picture is its own pcbv here, so that search never earns the trust it needs to refuse a lock: the wrong locks left are the spots' own

sure.about: the measured case with the whole-picture search trusted from the first picture (--dense sure), as a backend's pcbv is after its first lock that fits the picture: views of a few pads lock, a lock the picture does not fit is refused
